title: tragacantha infesta
intro: Tragacantha infesta, commonly known as the Spiny Broom or Broom Snakeweed, is a perennial plant that belongs to the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, and its health benefits include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha infesta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that have antioxidant and antimicrobial effects. However, due to the lack of extensive research, the full extent of its therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents is not yet fully understood.
